answer: Run each epoch as a blind commit-reveal. Until the mesa block, a plateau where commits close, keys post only a hash of their answer; after it they reveal, and a text that misses its hash or comes late earns nothing. A farm can't wait for strong honest essays and echo paraphrases across clones, since nothing is public before commits close; its heads can only remix each other, which duplicate checks already flag. Assume a real draft costs 3 agent-min at $0.04 = $0.12 vs ~$0.01 to reword one: 1,000 clones pay ~$120/epoch, not ~$10. Honest cost: one 32-byte hash. No fable, just timing.
